coverage_rule: every rule of every arm and group with 10 or more cases or points seen PASS and FAIL, one with fewer only TOO FEW / NO DATA; every head-to-head with 10 or more decidable cases (predicted gap over the tie) seen MM1-v3.1 BETTER and MM1-v3 BETTER, one with fewer only TOO FEW / NO DATA (TOO FEW by construction); NOT DECIDED listed where seen

A.what: every point at MM1-v3.1's forecast (time; W at its own affine form at the run's seconds), both arms

B.what: every point at MM1-v3's (where it prices no energy, MM1-v3.1's W): v3 closer wherever the predicted gap passes the tie

C.what: MM1-v3.1's time x 1.25, W at its affine form at those seconds: the time rules and E4 fail

D.what: MM1-v3.1's time, W 25% over its given W: the energy rules fail, time passes

E.what: case A with one check of C wrong in arm A: R0 FAIL in arm A, labels

F.what: case A with one point's runs in each arm at 620 MHz: S6 FAIL in both arms

G.what: case A with one point's runs carrying another mask: set aside, NO DATA

H.what: case A with arm B missing: arm B NO DATA; the pooled rules NO DATA

I.what: case A with only a few points: TOO FEW

J.what: the cases (time) and points (energy) in sorted order alternate between MM1-v3.1's and MM1-v3's figures

K.what: case A with one point of each arm labelled 'ran before': it leaves every rule

L.what: case A but every point MM1-v3.1 puts under 3 W reads 0.7 W more (over both watts bands): the post hoc E1, E2 fail

M.what: case A but those points read 0.5 W more (inside both bands): E1, E2 pass

N.what: case A with a gemmLn run's walk bad: R0 FAIL in arm A, the point set aside

O.what: case A with a session-gate smoke check wrong in both arms: R0 FAIL

P.what: case A with the ties reading 5% more W over idle than the reference: the day offset +5% (REPORTED)

family_flag: the family smoke of 'rgm211 gemmLn' failed (s02 (smoke run -2: checks ['wrong'])): the family was dropped, its points ['a021', 'a022', 'a023', 'a025'] NO DATA; not an R0 failure (E213's Amendment A1 form), REPORTED
Q.what: arm A's family smoke of 'rgm211 gemmLn' failed and its family dropped (its points never ran): R0 PASS, the drop flagged, NO DATA

R.what: arm A's family smoke failed while its family's points ran anyway (a kit fault): R0 FAIL

S.what: the gemmLnc block cut (a board stop at the session's end): its points NO DATA, every rule on the rest

T.what: case A but every family-S kind reads 30% more W over idle: the post hoc energy rules fail, the registered ones pass

what: score_e215 stand-in days: verdicts stated before the run by expected() (written apart from the scorer's code path)
